[h2][img width="616" height="53"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3489700/extras/3a67cae43d202cd157bbd33b90dd3219.webp?t=1760065361[/img][/h2][p]Experience the acclaimed PlayStation®5 hit Stellar Blade™ from Korean developers SHIFT UP, now optimized for PC.
[/p][p]
[/p][h2][img width="616" height="53"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3489700/extras/c6e2df3772c2f40364ef8f09e7fdae2d.webp?t=1760065361[/img][/h2][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3489700/extras/6eb438ae996a475a048ab832123f7a8c.poster.avif?t=1760065361" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3489700/extras/6eb438ae996a475a048ab832123f7a8c.webm?t=1760065361" webp="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3489700/extras/6eb438ae996a475a048ab832123f7a8c.webp?t=1760065361" width="616" height="348"][/imgvid][/p][p]The future of humanity is balanced on the edge of a blade. Ravaged by strange, powerful creatures, Earth has been abandoned, and what is left of the decimated human race has fled to a Colony in outer space.
[/p][p]
[/p][p]After travelling from the Colony, EVE arrives on the desolate remains of our planet with a clear-cut mission: to save humankind by reclaiming Earth from the Naytiba – the malevolent force that has devastated it.
[/p][p]
[/p][p]But as EVE tackles the Naytiba one-by-one, piecing together the mysteries of the past in the ruins of human civilization, she realizes that her mission is far from straightforward. In fact, almost nothing is as it seems…
[/p][p]
[/p][h2][img width="616" height="53"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3489700/extras/2917d99c87c674cfe94183bf374ae514.webp?t=1760065361[/img][/h2][p][/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3489700/extras/8097adf35cdfbe7b7c3b746f2693840e.poster.avif?t=1760065361" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3489700/extras/8097adf35cdfbe7b7c3b746f2693840e.webm?t=1760065361" webp="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3489700/extras/8097adf35cdfbe7b7c3b746f2693840e.webp?t=1760065361" width="616" height="348"][/imgvid][/p][p]Engage in blisteringly fast combat as you slash a path through the remnants of Earth. Unleash graceful yet brutal attacking combos, unlock new moves and weapon upgrades, and face epic boss encounters that will challenge both brain and brawn in equal measure.
[/p][p]
[/p][h2][img width="616" height="53"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3489700/extras/0a7baf1010e0bd3c064a87018e801ff1.webp?t=1760065361[/img][/h2][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3489700/extras/1d8bf487cb63cd517950a9044ab897bf.poster.avif?t=1760065361" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3489700/extras/1d8bf487cb63cd517950a9044ab897bf.webm?t=1760065361" webp="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3489700/extras/1d8bf487cb63cd517950a9044ab897bf.webp?t=1760065361" width="616" height="348"][/imgvid][/p][p]Become immersed in a highly detailed post-apocalyptic world that blends beauty and horror to spectacular effect. 
[/p][p]
[/p][h2][img width="616" height="53"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3489700/extras/e89962cb109329d142f497875ddf4f2c.webp?t=1760065361[/img][/h2][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3489700/extras/9a881bdac27f5f957e2b9604b67c4ede.poster.avif?t=1760065361" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3489700/extras/9a881bdac27f5f957e2b9604b67c4ede.webm?t=1760065361" webp="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3489700/extras/9a881bdac27f5f957e2b9604b67c4ede.webp?t=1760065361" width="616" height="348"][/imgvid][/p][p]Unravel a gripping human fate story, with mature themes, a thought-provoking narrative and emotionally-charged revelations from beginning to end.[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New content[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Test your skill and strength against the fearsome warrior Mann, the leader of the Sentinels in Boss Challenge Mode.
[/p][/*][*][p]Chinese and Japanese voice over and lip-sync support.
[/p][/*][*][p]25 costumes, three pairs of glasses and six pairs of earrings.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2][b]PC features[/b][/h2][p][b]Ultrawide monitor support[/b]
[/p][list][*][p]Journey across breathtaking science fiction-inspired environments through support for ultrawide screen setups, including 21:9 and 32:9 aspect ratios.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]PC optimized graphics[/b]
[/p][list][*][p]Bring this stunningly vibrant world to life with support for performance-enhancing technologies including NVIDIA DLSS 4 AI-powered graphics, NVIDIA DLAA image quality enhancement, NVIDIA Reflex system latency reduction, as well as AMD FSR 3. [/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Unlocked framerates[/b]
[/p][list][*][p]Unleash the full power of your hardware to unleash the full fury of EVE’s electrifying fighting style with support for high framerates and enhanced visual fluidity.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Texture pack support[/b]
[/p][list][*][p]Enrich the stellar Blade universe through a 4K option for the environment texture quality.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Controller and keyboard support[/b]
[/p][list][*][p]Leap into the adventure with a PlayStation DualSense® controller on a wired USB connection, or with full mouse and keyboard support.
[/p][/*][/list][p][u]Haptic feedback[/u]
[/p][list][*][p]Feel the thrill of combat as your blade slashes its way to victory, with sensations enriched by the DualSense controller’s responsive vibrations.
[/p][/*][/list][p][u]Adaptive triggers[/u]
[/p][list][*][p]Unleash devastating yet graceful acrobatic moves, and interact with the technological remnants of an abandoned Earth using the DualSense controller’s adaptive triggers.[/p][/*][/list]
data.strSnippet: Save humanity from extinction in post-apocalyptic action-adventure Stellar Blade™. Experience blistering combat and a twisting storyline as you unravel the mysteries of Earth’s downfall.
